datasets.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Saint Kitts and Nevis: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/saint-kitts-and-nevis-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]

entity.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta (Facebook)

lineage.description: Building footprints are extracted from commercial satellite imagery using machine learning techniques developed by Meta. These footprints are then combined with national census data and ancillary population statistics in partnership with Columbia University to disaggregate population counts to high-resolution grid cells. The resulting raster and CSV datasets provide spatially explicit demographic estimates for use in disaster risk exposure assessments.

sources.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta (Facebook)
sources.description: Machine learning models applied to commercially available satellite imagery to identify building footprints, used as the spatial basis for disaggregating population estimates.

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Provides general population estimates by overlaying publicly available census data and population statistics onto the building footprint layer to produce high-resolution gridded population maps.
